title: Store Claims Counter Card: Live Pet Health Guarantee Evidence by Guarantee Type
content:
A claim under the Live Pet Health Guarantee is made in store only; no guarantee type accepts a claim by phone, chat or app message. What the claim must be supported by depends on the guarantee type printed on the purchase record.

## Water testing (aquatic guarantee types)

| Guarantee type | In-store water test of a sample needed | Sample drawn no more than this many hours before the claim | Water parameters that must be within range |
|---|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | Yes | 24 | ammonia, nitrite, pH |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | Yes | 24 | ammonia, nitrite, pH, salinity |
| Live Coral Guarantee | Yes | 24 | ammonia, nitrite, pH, salinity, alkalinity |
| Small Animal Guarantee | No | 0 (no water test) | none |
| Bird Guarantee | No | 0 (no water test) | none |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | No | 0 (no water test) | none |

## Animal and veterinary evidence

| Guarantee type | Deceased animal or a dated photo presented | Veterinary exam record needed for an illness or death claim | Exam held within this many calendar days after the onset reported |
|---|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | Yes | No | 0 (no exam needed) |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | Yes | No | 0 (no exam needed) |
| Live Coral Guarantee | Yes | No | 0 (no exam needed) |
| Small Animal Guarantee | Yes | Yes | 3 |
| Bird Guarantee | Yes | Yes | 3 |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | Yes | Yes | 3 |

## Situations in which the guarantee does not apply

| Guarantee type | Situations listed for the type |
|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | a failed water test |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | a failed water test |
| Live Coral Guarantee | a failed water test |
| Small Animal Guarantee | injury after purchase; an improper habitat |
| Bird Guarantee | injury after purchase; an improper habitat |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | injury after purchase; an improper habitat; an improper heat source |

## Channel, purchase record and settlement time

| Guarantee type | Where a claim may be made | Purchase record may be found by the profile phone number instead of the paper receipt | Business days to settle a claim after the evidence is complete |
|---|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | in store only | Yes | 0 |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | in store only | Yes | 0 |
| Live Coral Guarantee | in store only | Yes | 0 |
| Small Animal Guarantee | in store only | Yes | 3 |
| Bird Guarantee | in store only | Yes | 3 |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | in store only | Yes | 3 |

## Reading the card

- **Sample age.** For the three aquatic types the sample must have been drawn within 24 hours before the claim. Hypothetical illustration: a sample drawn 20 hours before the claim meets the requirement; one drawn 30 hours before does not.
- **Exam timing.** For small animals, birds, reptiles and amphibians the exam takes place within 3 calendar days after the onset reported. Hypothetical illustration: onset reported on a Monday, an exam on the Wednesday of that week (2 days after) meets it; an exam on the following Monday (7 days after) does not.
- **Lost receipt.** Under every guarantee type the purchase record may be located by the phone number on the customer's profile, so a missing paper receipt does not by itself prevent the record from being found.
